newTerms.prebestowal conference / prebestowal cha: conferencia anterior al otorgamiento / encargo anterior al otorgamiento

forcedChoices.choice: tú for Immanuel's address to Michael (120:1.1 to 120:3.11)
forcedChoices.reason: Immanuel speaks as elder brother and comrade; the text is fraternal, not the respect form for a ruler.

forcedChoices.choice: Each paragraph of the charge opens with «, and only 120:3.11 closes with »
forcedChoices.reason: Mirrors the English, where each paragraph of the speech opens with a quote mark; each paragraph can be shown alone.

forcedChoices.choice: "the assurance of all Paradise" as «la garantía de todo el Paraíso»
forcedChoices.reason: Here assurance means a guarantee, not inner certainty; «seguridad» would read as safety.
The sense is to make amends for harm done by others; «expiar» would imply guilt of Michael.
The authors address the readers in the plural.

forcedChoices.choice: "one" as «uno» for God and man, «una» for Deity
forcedChoices.reason: Spanish gender agreement: Dios y hombre take masculine, Deidad is feminine.
Plural address to readers with ustedes; context makes the owner clear.
